title: Cynbit Studio
text: Cynbit Studio is an AI-powered career growth platform for students and developers. It includes placement assessment, adaptive coding paths, AI coding missions, AI code evaluation, AI mentor support, mock interviews, an AI resume engine, job matcher analysis, legacy profiles, XP and certificates.

title: TenantEase
text: TenantEase is a smart property and tenant management platform. It centralizes property management, tenant management and rent collection. It includes rent and payment tracking, automated reminders, payment history, unit tracking, tenant profiles and a business dashboard.

title: Revio
text: Revio is an AI-first reputation and review management system. It automates customer feedback management, synchronizes reviews across platforms, generates AI responses, provides sentiment intelligence, detects crises and supports centralized multi-location control.

title: BitElevate
text: BitElevate is Cynbit's training and technical development initiative focused on helping students build industry-ready software skills. The program includes technical learning, industry roadmaps and certification.

title: Cynbit Technologies
text: Cynbit Technologies is an AI automation and software solutions company based in Jaipur, Rajasthan. Its public positioning includes AI automation, autonomous AI agents, custom software development, scalable business platforms, cloud systems and digital marketing and SEO.
